sita: Quick sync — found a p95 regression in the nightly replay against the 1.3 runtime build. Noticed spikes when KV cache misses hit during long-tail sequences.
omar: Can you paste the tail sample?
sita: here's a trimmed example from the trace: 
```
request_id=abc123 seq_len=1024 kv_hits=0 kernel=matmul_v2 start=161234.12 ttft_ms=312 p95_ms=298 p99_ms=412
request_id=abc124 seq_len=32 kv_hits=1 kernel=fused_attn start=161234.45 ttft_ms=18 p95_ms=22
```
jen: Oof — looks like kernel selection is falling back to the generic path for >512 tokens, which is slower. Might be a kernel-choice threshold bug introduced in 1.3.
devon: Also seeing batching heuristic treat those long seqs as high-latency and split batches aggressively, which increases TPOT due to smaller parallelism.
sita: Agreed. Hypothesis: combined effect of (1) fallback kernel for long sequences, (2) aggressive batch splitting on seq_len > 256, (3) KV warmup causing initial miss storms -> inflated p95.
omar: We should reproduce with a synthetic microburst that mixes short/chatty (16-64) and long (512-1024) sequences at realistic ratios. Current replay harness uses uniform seq distribution so it's not catching the skew.
jen: +1. Proposal: add a "seq-aware" load profile that samples from production seq histogram and includes a 30s cold-start window to exercise KV warmup. We'll run apples-to-apples against old runtime and 1.3.
sita: Sample config (harness):
```
profiles:
  seq_aware:
    duration_s: 300
    phases:
      - name: cold_start
        duration_s: 30
        rate_qps: 50
        seq_dist: {short: 0.6, medium: 0.3, long: 0.1}
      - name: steady
        duration_s: 270
        rate_qps: 200
        seq_dist: {short: 0.65, medium: 0.25, long: 0.1}
```
devon: Also add metric exports for TTFT, TPOT, kernel_path, kv_hit_rate per-request. Need to correlate p95 jumps with kernel and kv_hit flags.
omar: Important: define TTFT vs TPOT precisely in the run notes so comparisons are apples-to-apples. My draft: TTFT = time from request start to first token emitted. TPOT = time spent on GPU for token generation (sum of per-token compute time) measured on host-side instrumentation.
jen: We must ensure both runtimes expose the same counters and same sampling frequency. Otherwise p95 differences could be measurement artifacts.
sita: agree. Also we should compute 'seq-aware goodput' = sum(tokens_generated for requests that finished within SLO)/wall_time to capture useful throughput (filters out long hung requests).
devon: For the experiment plan:
- baseline: run seq-aware profile against release/1.2 with kernel selection fixed to prefer fused_attn for seq<=1024
- candidate: run seq-aware against canary/1.3 (current)
- collect: TTFT p50/p95/p99, TPOT p50/p95, QPS, seq-aware-goodput, kv_hit_rate, kernel_path distributions
- thresholds: fail if p95 TTFT increases >12% or seq-aware goodput drops >8%
omar: I'll add a small script to postprocess the harness trace and produce kernel-path / kv hit rate joins. Quick pseudo: 
```
join traces on request_id -> produce table(request_id, seq_len, kv_hit, kernel, ttft_ms)
aggregate by kernel -> p95(ttft_ms), kv_hit_rate
```
jen: Nice. One more: we should include a microbenchmark focused on kernel latency vs seq len (single request ramp) to validate the threshold logic in the kernel selector. That isolates kernel regression from batching effects.
sita: Good call. Put that as step 0.
perf-bot: Test run scheduled by omar: seq-aware profile against canary/1.3 at 2026-06-02T09:00Z. CI job id: perf/seq-aware/7892. Logs will post to http://perf.redwood/internal/7892
omar: Thanks — I'll kick off baseline then candidate and attach diffs. Will also tag runtime team for kernel fallback fix if we confirm.
jen: If we find kernel-selection bug, let's add a unit test in kernel selector that asserts preferred kernel for seq lengths.
devon: Also consider KV eviction policy tweak — maybe keep a tiny LRU for sequences >256 for the cold window. Could be a config knob in prod.
sita: Action items: omar -> run experiments (today), devon -> microbenchmark script, jen -> add measurement spec to the PR, sita -> create issue for kernel selector test.
omar: Will update thread with results and a short CSV of metrics. :thumbsup:
